text:
Maria Chen: Hi — need to swap my oncall this Sunday 22:00-06:00. Flight got moved to the morning. Can someone cover?

Sam Patel: Would you be able to take a weekday swap instead? I can do the Sunday but prefer earlier in the week.

Maria Chen: I can take Fri 09:00-17:00 if that helps. If someone covers Sunday I'll leave a prewarm & handoff. Key risks: canary model fallback might get hit after 00:30 if load spikes (we have a late-night batch job). Prefill KV cache for common prefixes.

Deepak Rao: I can pick up the full Sun 22:00-06:00 if you leave prewarm steps. Please paste the commands / runbook.

Maria Chen: Handoff notes:
- Watch dedicated GPU pool redline on shard-3 (ooms seen last week)
- Canary fallback: model-redwood-3 -> model-redwood-3-quant
- Key runbook snippet to prewarm KV + prefix cache:
```
# run on staging-dedicated box with credentials
./prewarm-script.sh --model model-redwood-3 --prefixes /lists/top-100-prefixes.txt --parallel 8
# quick check
curl -sS https://console.redwood.example/api/health | jq .serving.shard3
```
- Slack alert channel: #eng-oncall
- If latency > 200ms for > 3 minutes, promote canary by running:
```
redwoodctl rollout promote canary/model-redwood-3-quant --shard shard-3
```

Lina Torres: I'll cover 23:00-02:00 overlap to help with the first two hours (can shadow). :thumbsup:

Deepak Rao: Thanks — I'll take 22:00-06:00. Maria, can you run the prewarm today evening and paste the output? I'll verify before I log off.

Maria Chen: Ran prewarm on my laptop just now, initial pass completed, logs attached (snippet):
```
INFO prewarm: sent 800 requests in 45s, avg 120ms
WARN kvcache: 3 prefixes missed (will backfill)
```
Posted full logs to s3://redwood-logs/maria/prewarm/2281234567.log

oncall-bot: shift assignment updated — Deepak Rao assigned for 2281234567 (Sun 22:00-06:00). Lina Torres partial overlap 23:00-02:00. :white_check_mark:

Sam Patel: Awesome, thanks all. Maria — safe travels! :airplane:

Deepak Rao: I'll do a quick health check at handoff + create a short follow-up thread if I see anything odd.
